contracts.intent: Expose the DriftLock command surface for install, extraction, context, checks, coverage, diffs, explanations, acceptance, and bundled skills.

must_not_change: Commands must read .drift/config.json before falling back to defaults.
Extract must remain the only command that writes the committed contract index.
--git-base must only be accepted together with --changed on check.

contracts.intent: Install DriftLock into a target project by creating managed config, scripts, dependency instructions, optional ESLint config, CI, skills, and examples.

must_not_change: Dry runs must report planned changes without writing project files.
Managed files must not overwrite existing files unless force is enabled.
Installer-generated projects must keep using a simple single-source config.

contracts.intent: List and install bundled DriftLock agent skills with provider-specific file layout and command templating.

must_not_change: Unknown requested skills must fail instead of being silently ignored.
Existing installed skills must require force before replacement.
Provider-specific filtering must preserve OpenAI, Claude, and Cursor layouts.

contracts.intent: Validate extracted Drift contracts against executable invariants, required-file coverage, and locked-contract baselines.

must_not_change: Locked contracts must compare against the committed index before passing.
Required contract checks must use the configured source files.
Schema extraction errors must not prevent valid contracts from being checked.

contracts.intent: Define and validate the DriftLock project config schema used by every CLI command.

must_not_change: Preserve default config compatibility for projects without .drift/config.json.
Keep config validation strict so ignored fields cannot look enforceable.

contracts.intent: Render concise Drift contract context for a target file or task so agents can plan edits against declared constraints.

must_not_change: File context must stay scoped to the requested file.
Task context must rank contracts from ids, files, intents, SSOT, invariants, and LLM notes.
Planning notes must continue telling agents to run diff and check after edits.

contracts.intent: Compare current Drift contracts with the committed index and format reviewer summaries for intentional contract changes.

must_not_change: Diff output must distinguish added, changed, and removed contracts.
Locked contract acceptance files must require a valid contract id and reason.
Git-scoped diffs must not report unrelated indexed contracts.

contracts.intent: Extract valid @drift contracts from TypeScript source while reporting schema, duplicate-id, and anchoring errors deterministically.

must_not_change: Only real TypeScript comments may be interpreted as Drift contracts.
Contract extraction must continue collecting errors across files.
Contract ordering must remain deterministic for generated indexes.

contracts.intent: Publish the DriftLock ESLint plugin rule map and recommended flat-config preset under the drift-lock namespace.

must_not_change: The recommended preset must enable every exported rule as an error.
Rule names must stay stable for downstream ESLint configs.
The plugin object must reference itself in the recommended config.

contracts.intent: Report silent edits to locked Drift contracts by comparing the current file against the committed Drift index during ESLint runs.

must_not_change: Missing indexes must be ignored so projects can lint before extraction.
Invalid indexes must be reported as lint failures.
Locked-change checks must stay scoped to the linted file.

contracts.intent: Report Drift SSOT flow violations through ESLint for contracts extracted from the file currently being linted.

must_not_change: The rule must only evaluate contracts extracted from the current file.
Every SSOT flow error must be forwarded through the shared reporter.

contracts.intent: Report Drift SSOT usage violations through ESLint for contracts extracted from the file currently being linted.

must_not_change: The rule must only evaluate contracts extracted from the current file.
Every SSOT usage error must be forwarded through the shared reporter.

contracts.intent: Report Drift contract syntax, schema, and anchoring errors through ESLint for the file currently being linted.

must_not_change: The rule must report every extractor error for the current file.
Filenames must be normalized relative to the configured root.
